title: OrganizationShape
description: Schema for Organization entities following Open Pulse Ontology v2.1.2. Optimized for LLM agent parsing with descriptive guidance. ID hierarchy: ror → infoscienceOrganizationIdentifier → githubOrganizationHandle → uuid. SHACL requires: schema:name AND at least ONE of (schema:identifier, pulse:githubOrganizationHandle, pulse:infoscienceOrganizationIdentifier).

id.description: Resolved hierarchical identifier. Set to the first non-null value from: pulse:ror, pulse:infoscienceOrganizationIdentifier, pulse:githubOrganizationHandle, or uuid (fallback). Example: 'https://ror.org/02s376052' or 'numpy'

identifiers.description: All available identifiers for this organization. Contains pulse:ror, pulse:infoscienceOrganizationIdentifier, pulse:githubOrganizationHandle, and uuid

pulse:ror.description: ROR (Research Organization Registry) identifier. Format: https://ror.org/XXXXXXXXX (9 alphanumeric chars). Example: 'https://ror.org/02s376052'

pulse:infoscienceOrganizationIdentifier.description: Infoscience organization identifier in canonical URL form (`https://infoscience.epfl.ch/entities/orgunit/<uuid>`). Example: 'https://infoscience.epfl.ch/entities/orgunit/95372c6b-7d45-432e-a84e-660c9fa54e05'

uuid.description: UUID4 fallback identifier. Always present. Example: 'e2c4b6a8-1d3f-4e5a-9b7c-8d6e4f2a1b3c'

idSource.description: Indicates which identifier was used as the primary 'id'. One of: 'pulse:ror', 'pulse:infoscienceOrganizationIdentifier', 'pulse:githubOrganizationHandle', or 'uuid'

schema:name.description: Organization name. Example: 'École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne'

pulse:infoscienceOrganizationIdentifier.description: Infoscience organization identifier in canonical URL form (`https://infoscience.epfl.ch/entities/orgunit/<uuid>`). Example: 'https://infoscience.epfl.ch/entities/orgunit/41674f42-ba15-4612-9817-2a6f60985c01'

org:hasUnit.description: Array of child OrganizationShape IDs (hierarchical). Example: ['https://infoscience.epfl.ch/entities/orgunit/95372c6b-7d45-432e-a84e-660c9fa54e05']

org:unitOf.description: Parent OrganizationShape IDs (hierarchical). Most orgs have 0 or 1 parent; arrays support joint affiliations (e.g. a research center jointly run by two universities). Example: ['https://ror.org/02s376052']

pulse:owns.description: Array of RepositoryShape IDs (GitHub handles) owned by this organization. Example: ['EPFL-ENAC/geodata-toolkit']
